bodySections.heading: Why timing matters
paragraphs: This senior cat plan sequences doses against kidney disease scheduling, not against a vague “sometime this season” intention for your cat.

Milestone labels on the senior cat table (Annual or risk-based; Legal interval; Lifestyle review) are operational deadlines for daycare, boarding, travel, and multi-pet intros — a nearly finished senior cat kitten series is still incomplete.

If your household also wrestles with stress of clinic trips or indoor risk reassessment, put those constraints on the same calendar thread as the FVRCP booster so one reminder system owns the senior cat week.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Call the clinic with product names and prior dates the day you notice a missed senior cat dose; catch-up timing depends on age and gap length for this cat scenario.
Until the senior cat series is current again, reduce the exposure pattern that matches kidney disease scheduling, and do not wait for an annual wellness slot to ask about a senior cat make-up dose.
After the visit, enable 7-, 3-, and 1-day nudges for the next FVRCP booster due date so the same senior cat miss cannot hide inside a shared family calendar.

faqs.question: Is this senior cat vaccine schedule a prescription?
faqs.answer: No. It is an editorial planning table aligned with common AAHA/AAFP-style windows and facility patterns. Your veterinarian sets the legal and medical plan for the individual cat.

faqs.question: What if we already missed a date on this senior cat schedule?
faqs.answer: Contact the clinic for catch-up timing. Bring prior records, limit high-risk exposure tied to kidney disease scheduling, and reset reminders as soon as the next senior cat due date is known.

faqs.question: How do reminders help with FVRCP booster?
faqs.answer: PetClues can nudge you 7, 3, and 1 day before that senior cat booster is due so boarding and travel deadlines stop arriving as surprises.
